# Allocation with a dependent class-formal carrier bound

The original C extends Collection<V> relation survives a primitive-initialized
container allocation forwarded to Parent<K,C>. The selected map constructor
must remain distinct from the Supplier<Map<K,C>> overload. Four frozen routes
compare 96 cases twice for source/SDK parents, compiling all generated Java and
auditing original entries and metadata. Raw capacity/float bits, real allocation,
input/result identities, callback order, partial writes, constructor failures
and later caller casts remain observable. Six wrong programs and six unchanged-
Code Signature controls protect the contract. Only owned fixtures execute.
